entries.title: Ratopia

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Ratopia left Early Access on Steam on April 30, 2025. It is a strategic survival/city-building game from Cassel Games, with Windows and macOS support. No console or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it has the cleanest capture/settings path and Workshop support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. macOS is a valid native alternative if that is the available local setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched 1.0 build.
